prompt: Check whether packet addresses fall inside the rule network `10.1.2.3/8` using `(addr & mask) == (net & mask)`, where `mask` keeps the leading 8 bits.

trace.label: The mask for `/0` must be set specially because
choices: a shift by 32 is undefined in C

explain: Masking the rule's own network drops the host bits in `10.1.2.3`, leaving 10.0.0.0, so A (10.x.x.x) matches and B (11.x.x.x) does not. For `/0` the mask would be `0xFFFFFFFF << 32`, which is undefined behaviour, so handle it as mask 0.
